comparison.objective: Route a first article after a production changeover, versus tune and lock a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Article routing/diversion is implied, versus bimanual tool engagement, rotary adjustment, locking, and response-driven iteration.
comparison.success_condition: The record gives no body, specs, routing destination, or numeric rubric. Candidate requires two safe repeatable stops within stroke and rebound limits.
comparison.reason: Routing an article tests material-flow handling, not adjustment of a retained mechanical damping element.
